---
name: Help, it doesn't work
about: Installer or game problem on your Mac
title: "[Help] "
labels: help
---

**What happened?** (what you clicked, what you saw)

**Which did you pick in the installer?** Look 1 / 2 / 3, and Microsoft or Offline.

**Your Mac:** chip (M1, M2...) and macOS version (Apple menu > About This Mac).

**Log link:** run this in Terminal and paste the link it prints:

```sh
/Applications/Horizon.app/Contents/MacOS/horizon-launcher share-log
```

Do not paste passwords, emails or account tokens.
